svg.text: DETAIL B: MOORING EYE AND LOAD PIN, 1:3
Designed for the chain breaking load, 40 kN: the chain fails first.
FEA peak 61 MPa at the hole edge, safety factor 2.8 on 316L.
Hand check: net section 33 MPa, pin bearing 71 MPa.
1. The lid is held by 8 tamper proof screws (16): only the
harbour staff key opens it. The O-ring (14) seals it (IP68).
2. To change the battery: undo 8 screws, lift the lid with the
cables, undo the strap (12), lift the battery out.
3. The antenna (35) is inside the polyethylene topmark,
which radio waves pass through, safe from birds and knocks.
4. The green buoy has the cone (37) in place of the can.
5. The load pin (39) is a strain gauged shackle pin: the
control unit reads the pull; zero pull = chain broken.
Third angle projection. Drawn from the CAD model with hidden line removal.
